This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew" /> [[Maby Sagedo]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Discord">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-03|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1357405484679958799|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Masseur-Species.png}}</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by [[Color|orange]] skin, [[Mouth|beaks]], and [[Lekku|head-tails]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During the [[New Republic Era]], by around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SC Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a member of this species could be found enjoying themselves in the company of another [[Unidentified beaked species|alien]] at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]].<ref name="Skeleton Crew" /> Later, by [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">{{SW|url=news/4-reasons-canto-bight-is-an-essential-read|text=4 Reasons ''Canto Bight'' Is an Essential Read}} states that [[Canto Bight (novella collection)|''Canto Bight'']] takes place a few [[Standard day|days]] prior to [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], which ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places in the same year as the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the Starkiller Incident in [[34 ABY]], meaning that both ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' and ''Canto Bight'' take place in the same year.</ref> a member of this species<ref name="Discord" /> by the name of [[Maby Sagedo]] worked as a [[masseur]] at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] in [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="Novella">{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)|audiobook=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Masseur-Alien-02.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Masseur Alien 02 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
This species was first set to appear during the scenes set at [[Zord's Spa and Bathhouse]] of the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], but these scenes were cut from the finished version of the film, instead first included in its Blu-ray and digital releases. In these scenes, a member of this species is working as a masseuse in the bathhouse when [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] who come crashing through on [[Fathier]]back.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}} {{C|Blu-ray featurette}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], with concept art for it was titled Masseur Alien 02,<ref name="TLJ Art Book">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> while their production code was "was "K066B species" or "King 66B."<ref name="Discord" />
